_readme: Upscaler defaults. Changes made in the web UI or with `upscale --set-tier`
are written to config/upscale.local.json, which overrides this file and is
gitignored, so local choices survive restarts without dirtying the repo.
tier: off | 1k | 2k | 3k | 4k. Targets for a 16:9 source are 1920x1080,
2048x1080, 3200x1800 and 3840x2160. Other aspect ratios keep their own
ratio and match the tier's long side instead, so nothing is distorted.
Note 2K is DCI 2K (1.896:1), not 16:9, so a 16:9 source is stretched ~5.8%
to fill 2048x1080. Set fit to "aspect" for 2048x1152 instead.
supersample: run the engine one native scale above what the target needs,
then downscale - the GAN synthesises larger and the downscale removes its
artifacts. Costs time and VRAM; set false for the smallest scale that fits.
model: realesr-animevideov3 ships native x2/x3/x4 and suits illustration;
